headline.title: GLM-5.2: Built for Long-Horizon Tasks
headline.summary: The GLM-5.2 model has been developed to enhance performance on long-horizon tasks, focusing on improved reasoning and planning capabilities. This advancement aims to address challenges in maintaining context and coherence over extended interactions.

articles.title: Pinterest launches an experimental AI shopping app called ‘Ask Pinterest’
articles.summary: Pinterest has introduced 'Ask Pinterest,' an experimental AI shopping app designed to provide users with personalized recommendations and inspiration via a conversational interface. This new tool aims to enhance the shopping experience on the platform by leveraging artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Unlocking UK house-building with AI-accelerated planning
articles.summary: The UK government has partnered with Google DeepMind to develop an AI-powered prototype designed to expedite housing planning decisions. This initiative aims to address the country's housing shortage by streamlining the planning process.

articles.title: The next humanoid robot might not look human at all
articles.summary: French startup Genesis AI has introduced Eno, a new humanoid robot that challenges traditional designs by potentially lacking a head and legs, instead featuring a wheeled base and a foldable structure. The company emphasizes that humanoid robots do not need to resemble humans to be effective.

articles.title: From the Hugging Face Hub to robot hardware with Strands Agents and LeRobot
articles.summary: Hugging Face has expanded its offerings by integrating Strands Agents and LeRobot, enabling the deployment of AI models from the Hugging Face Hub directly onto robotic hardware. This collaboration aims to enhance the capabilities of robots by leveraging advanced AI technologies for improved performance in various applications.

articles.title: SpaceX valuation balloons to $2.6T, briefly passes Amazon
articles.summary: SpaceX's valuation has surged to $2.6 trillion, briefly surpassing Amazon's market value. This increase of $1 trillion follows the commencement of trading for its shares on Friday.

articles.title: Nothing from Something: Can a Language Model Discover 0?
articles.summary: A recent study explores the potential of AI systems, particularly those based on artificial neural networks, to extend human mathematical knowledge by discovering new mathematical concepts. The research emphasizes the importance of out-of-distribution generalization for these systems to hypothesize and develop innovative mathematical structures beyond their training data.

articles.title: Towards Distributed Inference of LLMs on a P2P Network
articles.summary: The article presents a decentralized routing scheme for peer-to-peer (P2P) serving of large language models (LLMs) that utilizes prefix caching to reduce inference latency. By maintaining local radix trees of cached prefixes and employing periodic anti-entropy to refresh peer cache estimates, the proposed method aims to improve cache reuse across distributed nodes.

articles.title: Agentic Discovery of Non-Canonical Antimicrobial Peptides with AMPGAN v3
articles.summary: Researchers have developed AMPGAN v3, a multi-objective conditional GAN designed to generate antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) that incorporate non-natural amino acids and chemical modifications. This advancement aims to address the limitations of existing generative models in the design of effective peptide drugs to combat antimicrobial resistance.

articles.title: MLLP-VRAIN UPV system for the IWSLT 2026 Simultaneous Speech Translation task
articles.summary: The MLLP-VRAIN research group has submitted their approach for the IWSLT 2026 Simultaneous Speech Translation task, utilizing the Parakeet and Qwen 3.5 models to develop a cascaded solution for long-form SimulST. Their work focuses on adaptive "black-box" policies and explores relaxations of these policies to improve quality-latency trade-offs.

articles.title: SegTME-UNI2: A Foundation Model-Based Framework for Generalisable Multiclass Cell Segmentation and LLM-Driven Tumour Microenvironment Characterisation in Histopathology
articles.summary: The SEGTME-UNI2 framework offers a foundation model-based approach for multiclass cell segmentation and characterisation of the tumour microenvironment in histopathology using H&E-stained images. It integrates a dual-head segmentation model that combines the UNI2-H pathology model with advanced segmentation techniques to enhance feature extraction and clinical reporting.

articles.title: ED3R: Energy-Aware Distributed Disaster Detection Enabled by Cooperative Robotic Agents
articles.summary: The paper presents ED3R, an energy-aware distributed framework designed for cooperative robotic agents to enhance disaster detection and environmental monitoring. It emphasizes the importance of balancing detection confidence with energy management and operational constraints during critical missions, such as wildfire response.
